Hello, my friend 🙂
I’m doing well, thank you.
Thanks for your message.
We are a company in China focusing on vehicle supply and export, including used and new cars.
May I know what kind of vehicles you are interested in?
Is it for personal use or for business?
Looking forward to your reply.
He is the amount of the car yes year 2022

Thank you for your message.
To be honest, with a budget of 5,000 USD and looking for a 2022 year vehicle, the options will be quite limited.
At this price level, it would usually only be possible to consider:
- a very small car, or
- an older / basic vehicle with limited configuration.
Finding a car that is both recent (2022) and low-priced is not easy, but I can still check what options may be available based on your expectations.
Could you please let me know:
1) Which country and city the car will be delivered to?
2) Is the 5,000 USD budget for the car only, or including delivery and export costs?
Then I can advise you more accurately.
But if you have cargo, we will pay for it.
If you find it on this site, please send me a photo of the car.

Sure, no problem.
Once I find a suitable option on this site, I will send you the car photos, basic information, and price for your reference.
Please allow me a little time to check carefully.

Hello, my friend 😊
May I kindly ask if your request is urgent or not?
I would like to let you know that the Chinese New Year holiday is coming very soon. During this period, many suppliers and logistics companies in China will temporarily stop or slow down operations.
If it is not very urgent, I can start matching suitable cars for you immediately after the holiday, and I will handle it more efficiently and carefully.
Please let me know if you are able to wait until after the Chinese New Year, or if you need something urgently now.
Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to your reply.

Hello, my friend.
Sorry for the late reply, and thank you for your patience.
We are still following up and matching suitable vehicle options for you. Please don’t worry, we will organize the relevant information and send it to you for reference as soon as possible.
If you now have any more specific requirements, such as vehicle model, budget, quantity, or other preferences, you can also tell us directly, and we will match more suitable options for you more quickly.
Thank you for your understanding and support.

Hello my friend 👋
Nice to hear from you again.

For example: SUV, pickup, sedan — or your budget range?
I can send you some good options with price and photos right away 👍
2022 How much does it cost, White or Snow, and Corolla is also possible which is a 2022 sedan

Б/у, но в хорошем состоянии, наш бюджет около  5 тысяч.

Понял вас, мой друг. Спасибо за уточнение.
Что касается Kia K3 и Toyota Corolla 2022 года: это отличные и надежные машины. Однако, должен быть честен с вами — бюджет в 5000$ для этих моделей 2022 года (в хорошем состоянии и с учетом доставки) довольно низкий.
Чтобы не предлагать вам битые или проблемные авто, я могу сделать следующее:
1. Поискать варианты этих моделей чуть постарше (например, 2018-2019 гг.), которые пройдут в ваш бюджет.
2. Или поискать другие надежные седаны в отличном состоянии за 5000$.
Что вы об этом думаете? Я хочу подобрать для вас действительно качественный автомобиль, который прослужит долго.
